<style>
/* ── Hacker theme overrides ── */
:root {
  --green: #00ff41;
  --green-dim: #00cc33;
  --green-dark: #004d14;
  --cyan: #00ffff;
  --red: #ff4d6d;
  --bg: #0d0d0d;
  --card: #111;
  --border: rgba(0,255,65,0.18);
  --muted: #4a9e5c;
  --text: #ccffcc;
}

body { background: #0d0d0d !important; font-family: 'Courier New', monospace !important; }
.wrapper { max-width: 960px !important; }
header { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border) !important; }
header h1 { color: var(--green) !important; font-size: 1.1rem !important; letter-spacing: 3px; }
section { color: var(--text) !important; }
a { color: var(--green) !important; }
a:hover { color: var(--cyan) !important; }

/* SCAN LINE */
body::before {
  content: '';
  position: fixed; inset: 0;
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent, transparent 2px, rgba(0,255,65,0.015) 2px, rgba(0,255,65,0.015) 4px);
  pointer-events: none; z-index: 999;
}

/* HERO */
.hero {
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 2rem;
  margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
  background: rgba(0,255,65,0.03);
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 180px 1fr;
  gap: 2rem;
  align-items: center;
}
.hero-photo {
  width: 180px; height: 210px;
  object-fit: cover; object-position: top;
  border: 2px solid var(--green);
  filter: grayscale(20%) contrast(1.1) sepia(10%);
  display: block;
}
.hero-photo-wrap { position: relative; }
.photo-overlay {
  position: absolute; inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent 60%, rgba(0,255,65,0.15));
  pointer-events: none;
}
.hero-name {
  font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--green) !important;
  letter-spacing: 3px; margin: 0 0 0.3rem;
  text-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0,255,65,0.4);
}
.hero-role {
  color: var(--cyan); font-size: 0.85rem;
  letter-spacing: 2px; margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
}
.hero-desc { color: #88bb88; font-size: 0.82rem; line-height: 1.8; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
.badge-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.5rem; }
.badge {
  padding: 0.2rem 0.7rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  letter-spacing: 1px;
  color: var(--green);
  background: rgba(0,255,65,0.05);
}
.badge.on { border-color: var(--green); background: rgba(0,255,65,0.12); }
.stat-row { display: flex; gap: 2rem; margin-top: 1rem; }
.stat { text-align: center; }
.stat-n { font-size: 1.4rem; color: var(--green); font-weight: 700; }
.stat-l { font-size: 0.6rem; color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: 2px; }

/* SECTION HEADINGS */
.sec-head {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding-bottom: 0.4rem;
  margin: 2.5rem 0 1.5rem;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.8rem;
}
.sec-head h2 {
  color: var(--green) !important;
  font-size: 0.9rem !important;
  letter-spacing: 4px !important;
  margin: 0 !important;
  border: none !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}
.sec-prefix { color: #ff4d6d; font-size: 0.85rem; }
.sec-line { flex: 1; height: 1px; background: var(--border); }

/* TERMINAL BLOCK */
.terminal {
  background: #080808;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.term-bar {
  background: #151515;
  padding: 0.4rem 0.8rem;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.dot { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; }
.dot-r { background: #ff5f57; }
.dot-y { background: #febc2e; }
.dot-g { background: #28c840; }
.term-title { font-size: 0.6rem; color: var(--muted); margin: 0 auto; letter-spacing: 2px; }
.term-body { padding: 1rem 1.2rem; font-size: 0.78rem; line-height: 1.9; }
.t-p { color: var(--green); }
.t-c { color: #ccffcc; }
.t-o { color: var(--muted); padding-left: 1rem; display: block; }
.t-k { color: var(--cyan); }
.t-v { color: #ffcc00; }
.t-cursor { display: inline-block; width: 7px; height: 13px; background: var(--green); animation: blink 1s infinite; vertical-align: middle; }

/* CARDS */
.card {
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 1.2rem 1.4rem;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  background: rgba(0,255,65,0.02);
  transition: border-color 0.3s, background 0.3s;
  position: relative;
}
.card:hover { border-color: rgba(0,255,65,0.4); background: rgba(0,255,65,0.05); }
.card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0;
  width: 2px;
  background: var(--green);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.3s;
}
.card:hover::before { opacity: 1; }

.card-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.3rem; margin-bottom: 0.3rem; }
.card-title { color: var(--green) !important; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; }
.card-period { font-size: 0.65rem; color: var(--cyan); border: 1px solid rgba(0,255,255,0.2); padding: 0.15rem 0.5rem; letter-spacing: 1px; }
.card-sub { font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--cyan); margin-bottom: 0.8rem; letter-spacing: 1px; }
.card-sub .present { color: var(--green); font-weight: 700; animation: pulse 2s infinite; }
.bullets { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; }
.bullets li { font-size: 0.78rem; color: #88bb88; line-height: 1.7; padding-left: 1.2rem; position: relative; padding-top: 0.1rem; }
.bullets li::before { content: '>'; position: absolute; left: 0; color: var(--green); }

/* SKILLS */
.skill-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 1.5rem; }
.skill-group { margin-bottom: 1rem; }
.skill-group-title { font-size: 0.65rem; color: var(--cyan); letter-spacing: 3px; margin-bottom: 0.6rem; }
.tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.4rem; }
.tag {
  font-size: 0.65rem; padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  color: var(--text);
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  transition: all 0.2s;
  cursor: default;
}
.tag:hover { border-color: var(--green); color: var(--green); background: rgba(0,255,65,0.08); }
.tag.sec { border-color: rgba(255,77,109,0.25); color: #ff9999; }
.tag.sec:hover { border-color: var(--red); color: var(--red); background: rgba(255,77,109,0.08); }
.tag.cloud { border-color: rgba(0,255,255,0.2); color: #99ffff; }
.tag.cloud:hover { border-color: var(--cyan); color: var(--cyan); background: rgba(0,255,255,0.08); }

/* PROJECTS */
.proj-card {
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 1.4rem;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  background: rgba(0,255,65,0.02);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: all 0.3s;
}
.proj-card:hover { border-color: rgba(0,255,65,0.4); transform: translateX(4px); }
.proj-num { font-size: 2.5rem; color: rgba(0,255,65,0.07); line-height: 1; margin-bottom: -0.3rem; font-weight: 700; }
.proj-name { color: var(--green); font-size: 0.92rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 0.4rem; }
.proj-desc { font-size: 0.78rem; color: #88bb88; line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 0.6rem; }
.proj-highlight { font-size: 0.72rem; color: var(--cyan); border-left: 2px solid var(--cyan); padding-left: 0.6rem; margin-top: 0.6rem; }

/* CERTS */
.cert-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 0.8rem; }
.cert-card {
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 0.9rem 1rem;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.8rem;
  background: rgba(0,255,65,0.02);
  transition: all 0.3s;
}
.cert-card:hover { border-color: rgba(0,255,65,0.35); background: rgba(0,255,65,0.05); }
.cert-icon { font-size: 1.2rem; width: 36px; text-align: center; flex-shrink: 0; }
.cert-name { font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--text); font-weight: 700; }
.cert-org { font-size: 0.62rem; color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: 1px; }

/* CONTACT */
.contact-links { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.6rem; }
.contact-link {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem;
  padding: 0.8rem 1rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  text-decoration: none !important;
  color: var(--text) !important;
  background: rgba(0,255,65,0.02);
  transition: all 0.3s;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}
.contact-link:hover { border-color: var(--green); color: var(--green) !important; transform: translateX(6px); background: rgba(0,255,65,0.05); }
.cl-icon { width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 1px solid var(--border); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 0.9rem; flex-shrink: 0; }
.cl-label { font-size: 0.58rem; color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: 2px; display: block; }

/* FOOTER */
.footer-term {
  margin-top: 3rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding-top: 1rem;
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  color: var(--muted);
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  text-align: center;
}

/* ANIMATIONS */
@keyframes blink { 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:0} }
@keyframes pulse { 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:0.5} }

/* RESPONSIVE */
@media(max-width:640px){
  .hero { grid-template-columns: 1fr; text-align: center; }
  .hero-photo { margin: 0 auto; }
  .badge-row, .stat-row { justify-content: center; }
  .skill-grid, .cert-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
</style>
